_doc: Lanes for Cleanshot. Read by `lanes` (main, fold.bar) and by the /lanes:* commands and seats. Design: ~/dotfiles/docs/lanes.md. No fleet machine runs Windows: the bar cross-checks the Windows targets and runs host tests for the pure crates; linking and runtime proof are GitHub Actions on windows-latest.

seats.name: capture
seats.domain: capture and app shell: crates/cleanshot-win (Win32 capture, Direct2D overlay, clipboard, DPI, DLL hardening, single instance, policy, file save; the only unsafe crate) and crates/cleanshot-app (main, lifecycle, tray, hotkeys, wiring); plus workspace build config, deny.toml, CI workflows and licences

seats.name: editor
seats.domain: document, export and editor: crates/cleanshot-core (Document, Shape, Command, undo, settings types), crates/cleanshot-render (flatten, redaction, encode, golden tests) and crates/cleanshot-editor (GPUI editor and settings window)

suites.Cargo.toml: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo deny check
